$meta.note: Player-facing UI strings, hand-authored as screens are built (P2.5). Every ui component renders text through this catalogue via t(); the eslint rule iw/no-hardcoded-jsx-text rejects hardcoded JSX text in packages/ui, and its negative control lives in packages/ui/src/i18n-check.control.test.ts. The Hindi edition translates this file.
